question: With reference to the G7 summit held in June 2026, consider the following statements: 1. The summit was hosted by France. 2. India attended the summit as an invitee/partner country, not as a member. 3. The G7 consists of the USA, the UK, France, Germany, Italy, Japan and Canada. How many of the statements given above are correct?
explanation: France held the 2026 G7 presidency and hosted at Evian-les-Bains; India attended as an invitee/partner (not a member); the seven members are the US, UK, France, Germany, Italy, Japan and Canada.
subject: GS2 International Relations

question: Consider the following statements regarding a recent Supreme Court judgment on homemakers: 1. It introduced a new compensatory head called 'Loss of Domestic Care' in motor-accident claims. 2. It relied on the National Statistical Office's Time Use Survey, 2019. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
explanation: In Shishu Pal v. Surjeet (2026) the SC created the 'Loss of Domestic Care' head and relied on the NSO Time Use Survey 2019 (unpaid domestic work approx. 15-17% of GDP).
subject: GS1 Society / GS2 Polity
micro_topic: SC homemaker compensation judgment (Shishu Pal v. Surjeet, 2026)

question: With reference to the Children's Climate Risk Report 2026, consider the following statements: 1. It is released by UNICEF. 2. It found that an overwhelming majority of children in India are exposed to extreme heat. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
explanation: The Children's Climate Risk Report 2026 is a UNICEF publication; it found that about 92% of Indian children (around 392 million) are exposed to extreme heat.
subject: GS3 Environment

question: Consider the following statements: 1. The AD-1 and AD-2 interceptors are part of India's Ballistic Missile Defence (BMD) programme. 2. NASM-MR, recently flight-tested by DRDO, is a naval anti-ship missile. 3. The recent tests were conducted from the Integrated Test Range, Chandipur, Odisha. How many of the statements given above are correct?
explanation: AD-1/AD-2 are Phase-II BMD interceptors; NASM-MR is a naval anti-ship missile (maiden test); all three tests were conducted from ITR Chandipur, Odisha (10-11 June 2026).
subject: GS3 Science & Technology

question: With reference to India's Ballistic Missile Defence (BMD) programme, consider the following statements: 1. Its Phase-I uses the Prithvi Air Defence (PAD) and Advanced Air Defence (AAD) interceptors. 2. It is designed to intercept incoming missiles in both the exo-atmospheric and endo-atmospheric phases. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
explanation: Phase-I of India's BMD uses PAD (exo-atmospheric, high-altitude) and AAD (endo-atmospheric, low-altitude) interceptors, providing a two-layered intercept across both phases.
subject: GS3 Science & Technology

question: The Time Use Survey in India, which measures the time spent on unpaid domestic and caregiving work, is conducted by which of the following?
options: (c) The Office of the Registrar General (Census of India)
explanation: India's first comprehensive Time Use Survey was conducted in 2019 by the National Statistical Office (NSO) under the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI).
subject: GS3 Economy
micro_topic: Time Use Survey and unpaid work measurement
